# free5GC-helm

[![Helm charts linting](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/actions/workflows/helm-charts-testing.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/actions/workflows/helm-charts-testing.yml)
[![CNTi essential](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/raw/badges/cnti-badge.svg)](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/actions/workflows/cnti.yml)

***free5gc-helm*** is an open-source project implemented to provide helm charts in order to deploy on one click a 5G system (RAN+SA 5G core) on top of Kubernetes. It currently relies on free5GC for the core network and free-ran-ue or UERANSIM to simulate Radio Access Network.

## Documentation
The documentation is available on the [free5GC official site](https://free5gc.org/guide/7-free5gc-helm/).

## Motivations
Please consult this [link](/motivations.md) to see the motivations that have led to this project.

## Contributing
Moving towards a Cloud native model for the 5G system is not a simple task. We welcome all new [contributions](./CONTRIBUTING.md) making this project better!

## Acknowledgement
Thanks to both Free5GC and UERANSIM teams for their great efforts.

## License
***free5gc-helm*** is under [Apache 2.0](./LICENSE) license.

## Citation

```
A. Khichane, I. Fajjari, N. Aitsaadi and M. Gueroui, "Cloud Native 5G: an Efficient Orchestration of Cloud Native 5G System," NOMS 2022-2022 IEEE/IFIP Network Operations and Management Symposium, Budapest, Hungary, 2022, pp. 1-9, doi: 10.1109/NOMS54207.2022.9789856.
```

global:
  name: free5gc
  # Selects the SMF and UPF topology; no chart files need to be copied.
  userPlaneArchitecture: ulcl  # supported values: "single" and "ulcl"
  uesubnet: 10.60.0.0/16  # UE IP address pool
  nrf:
    service:
      name: nrf-nnrf
      type: ClusterIP
      port: "8000"
      nodePort: "30800"
  sbi:
    scheme: http
  
  # AMF Multus CNI Configuration
  amf:
    multus:
      enabled: false  # Default: disabled for cloud-native deployments
      n2if:  # NGAP interface (used when multus.enabled=true)
        ipAddress: 10.100.50.249
      n2network:
        enabled: true
        name: n2network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.248
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.254
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.254
    service:
      ngap:
        enabled: true  # Enable NGAP service for external access
        name: amf-n2
        port: 38412
        # Used only with NodePort or LoadBalancer; set 0 for automatic allocation.
        nodeport: 31412
        protocol: SCTP
        type: ClusterIP
  
  # SMF Multus CNI Configuration
  smf:
    multus:
      enabled: false  # Default: disabled for cloud-native deployments
      n4if:  # PFCP interface (used when multus.enabled=true)
        ipAddress: 10.100.50.244
      n4network:
        enabled: true
        name: n4network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.240
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.246
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.246
  
  # UPF Multus CNI Configuration
  upf:
    multus:
      enabled: false  # Default: disabled for cloud-native deployments
      # Static IP configurations for UPF instances (used when multus.enabled=true)
      upf:
        n3if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.233
        n4if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.241
        n6if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.100.11
      psaupf1:
        n4if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.242
        n6if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.100.12
        n9if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.225
      psaupf2:
        n4if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.243
        n6if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.100.13
        n9if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.226
      iupf1:
        n3if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.234
        n4if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.245
        n6if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.100.14
        n9if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.227
      n3network:
        enabled: true
        name: n3network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.232
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.238
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.238
      n4network:
        enabled: true
        name: n4network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.240
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.246
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.246
      n6network:
        enabled: true
        name: n6network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth1
        subnetIP: 10.100.100.0
        cidr: 24
        gatewayIP: 10.100.100.1
        excludeIP: 10.100.100.254
      n9network:
        enabled: true
        name: n9network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.224
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.230
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.230


# These parameters can be used to enable/disable deployment of subcharts
deployMongoDb: true
deployAmf: true
deployAusf: true
deployBsf: true
deployChf: true
deployN3iwf: false
deployNef: true
deployNrf: true
deployNssf: true
deployPcf: true
deploySmf: true
deployScp: true
deployUdm: true
deployUdr: true
deployUpf: true
deployWebui: true
deployDbPython: false

# Disable the deployment of mongodb as an NRF subchart
free5gc-nrf:
  db:
    enabled: false

# This section can be used to override the default values in the MongoDB chart
mongodb:
  fullnameOverride: "mongodb"
  useStatefulSet: true
  auth:
    enabled: false
  persistence:
    size: 6Gi
    mountPath: /bitnami/mongodb/data/db/
  service:
    name: mongodb
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 27017
    nodePort: "30017"

# free5gc-upf Helm chart

This is a Helm chart for deploying the [free5GC](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc) UPF on Kubernetes.

This chart is included in the [dependencies](/charts/free5gc/charts) of the [main chart](/charts/free5gc). Furthermore, it can be installed separately on Kubernetes a cluster at the same network with the clusters other Free5GC NFs are deployed.

## Prerequisites
 - A Kubernetes cluster ready to use with all worker nodes using kernel `5.0.0-23-generic` and they should contain gtp5g kernel module.
 - [Multus-CNI](https://github.com/intel/multus-cni).
 - [Helm3](https://helm.sh/docs/intro/install/).
 - [Kubectl](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/tools/install-kubectl/) (optional).
 - A physical network interface on each Kubernetes node named `eth0`.
 - A physical network interface on each Kubernetes node named `eth1` to connect the UPF to the Data Network.
**Note:** If the names of network interfaces on your Kubernetes nodes are different from `eth0` and `eth1`, see [Networks configuration](#networks-configuration).

## Quickstart guide

### Verify the kernel version on worker nodes
```console
uname -r
```
It should be `5.0.0-23-generic`.

### Install the gtp5g kernel module on worker nodes
Please follow [Free5GC's wiki](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc/wiki/Installation#c-install-user-plane-function-upf).

### Install the user plane
Run the following commands on a host that can communicate with the API server of your cluster.
```console
kubectl create ns <namespace>
helm -n <namespace> install <release-name> ./free5gc-upf/
```

### Check the state of the created pod
```console
kubectl -n <namespace> get pods -l "project=free5gc"
```

### Uninstall the user plane
```console
helm -n <namespace> delete <release-name>
```
Or...
```console
helm -n <namespace> uninstall <release-name>
```

## Configuration

### Enable the ULCL feature
If you want to enable the ULCL feature, you can use the [ulcl-enabled-values.yaml](./ulcl-enabled-values.yaml) to override the default chart values.

### Networks configuration
In this section, we'll suppose that you have only one interface on each Kubernetes node and its name is `toto`. Then you have to set these parameters to `toto`:
 - `global.n2network.masterIf`
 - `global.n3network.masterIf`
 - `global.n4network.masterIf`
 - `global.n6network.masterIf`

In addition, please make sure `global.n6network.subnetIP`, `global.n6network.gatewayIP` and `upf.n6if.ipAddress` parameters will match the IP address of the `toto` interface in order to make the UPF able to reach the Data Network via its N6 interface.

In case of ULCL enabled take care about `iupf1.n6if.ipAddress`, `psaupf1.n6if.ipAddress` and `psaupf2.n6if.ipAddress` instead of `upf.n6if.ipAddress`.

## Customized installation
This chart allows you to customize its installation. The table below shows the parameters that can be modified before installing the chart or when upgrading it as well as their default values.

### Global parameters
| Parameter | Description | Default value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `global.projectName` | The name of the project. | `free5gc` |
| `global.userPlaneArchitecture` | User plane topology. Possible values are `single` and `ulcl` | `single` |

### N3 Network parameters
| Parameter | Description | Default value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `global.n3network.enabled` | If `true` then N3-related Network Attachment Definitions resources will be created. | `true` |
| `global.n3network.name` | N3 network name. | `n3network` |
| `global.n3network.masterIf` | N3 network MACVLAN master interface. | `eth0` |
| `global.n3network.subnetIP` | N3 network subnet IP address. | `10.100.50.232` |
| `global.n3network.cidr` | N3 network cidr. | `29` |

# free5gc-upf Helm chart

This is a Helm chart for deploying the [free5GC](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc) UPF on Kubernetes.

This chart is included in the [dependencies](/charts/free5gc/charts) of the [main chart](/charts/free5gc). Furthermore, it can be installed separately on Kubernetes a cluster at the same network with the clusters other Free5GC NFs are deployed.

## Prerequisites
 - A Kubernetes cluster ready to use with all worker nodes using kernel `5.0.0-23-generic` and they should contain gtp5g kernel module.
 - [Multus-CNI](https://github.com/intel/multus-cni).
 - [Helm3](https://helm.sh/docs/intro/install/).
 - [Kubectl](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/tools/install-kubectl/) (optional).
 - A physical network interface on each Kubernetes node named `eth0`.
 - A physical network interface on each Kubernetes node named `eth1` to connect the UPF to the Data Network.
**Note:** If the names of network interfaces on your Kubernetes nodes are different from `eth0` and `eth1`, see [Networks configuration](#networks-configuration).

## Quickstart guide

### Verify the kernel version on worker nodes
```console
uname -r
```
It should be `5.0.0-23-generic`.

### Install the gtp5g kernel module on worker nodes
Please follow [Free5GC's wiki](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc/wiki/Installation#c-install-user-plane-function-upf).

### Install the user plane
Run the following commands on a host that can communicate with the API server of your cluster.
```console
kubectl create ns <namespace>
helm -n <namespace> install <release-name> ./free5gc-upf/
```

### Check the state of the created pod
```console
kubectl -n <namespace> get pods -l "project=free5gc"
```

### Uninstall the user plane
```console
helm -n <namespace> delete <release-name>
```
Or...
```console
helm -n <namespace> uninstall <release-name>
```

## Configuration

### Enable the ULCL feature
If you want to enable the ULCL feature, you can use the [ulcl-enabled-values.yaml](./ulcl-enabled-values.yaml) to override the default chart values.

### Networks configuration
In this section, we'll suppose that you have only one interface on each Kubernetes node and its name is `toto`. Then you have to set these parameters to `toto`:
 - `global.n2network.masterIf`
 - `global.n3network.masterIf`
 - `global.n4network.masterIf`
 - `global.n6network.masterIf`

In addition, please make sure `global.n6network.subnetIP`, `global.n6network.gatewayIP` and `upf.n6if.ipAddress` parameters will match the IP address of the `toto` interface in order to make the UPF able to reach the Data Network via its N6 interface.

In case of ULCL enabled take care about `iupf1.n6if.ipAddress`, `psaupf1.n6if.ipAddress` and `psaupf2.n6if.ipAddress` instead of `upf.n6if.ipAddress`.

## Customized installation
This chart allows you to customize its installation. The table below shows the parameters that can be modified before installing the chart or when upgrading it as well as their default values.

### Global parameters
| Parameter | Description | Default value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `global.projectName` | The name of the project. | `free5gc` |
| `global.userPlaneArchitecture` | User plane topology. Possible values are `single` and `ulcl` | `single` |

### N3 Network parameters
| Parameter | Description | Default value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `global.n3network.enabled` | If `true` then N3-related Network Attachment Definitions resources will be created. | `true` |
| `global.n3network.name` | N3 network name. | `n3network` |
| `global.n3network.masterIf` | N3 network MACVLAN master interface. | `eth0` |
| `global.n3network.subnetIP` | N3 network subnet IP address. | `10.100.50.232` |
| `global.n3network.cidr` | N3 network cidr. | `29` |

#
{{- with .Values.smf }}
{{- $arch := $.Values.global.userPlaneArchitecture | default "ulcl" }}
{{- if not (or (eq $arch "single") (eq $arch "ulcl")) }}
{{- fail "global.userPlaneArchitecture must be either single or ulcl" }}
{{- end }}
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "free5gc-smf.fullname" $ }}-configmap
  labels:
    app: {{ $.Values.global.projectName }}
data:
  smfcfg.yaml: |
    info:
      version: 1.0.7
      description: SMF initial local configuration

    configuration:
      serviceNameList:
        {{- .configuration.serviceNameList | nindent 8 }}

      sbi:
        scheme: {{ $.Values.global.sbi.scheme }}
        registerIPv4: {{ include "free5gc-smf.fullname" $ }}-service # IP used to register to NRF
        bindingIPv4: 0.0.0.0  # IP used to bind the service
        port: {{ .service.port }}
        tls:
          verify: {{ .configuration.sbi.tls.verify }}
          key: ./cert/smf.key
          pem: ./cert/smf.pem
{{- if $.Values.smf.configuration.metrics.enable }}
      metrics: 
        enable: true
        scheme: {{ $.Values.smf.configuration.metrics.scheme }}
        bindingIPv4: 0.0.0.0  # IP used to bind the service
        port: {{ $.Values.smf.configuration.metrics.port }}
        namespace: {{ $.Values.smf.configuration.metrics.namespace }}
        tls:
          key: ./cert/smf.key
          pem: ./cert/smf.pem
{{- end }}
      nrfUri: {{ $.Values.global.sbi.scheme }}://{{ $.Values.global.nrf.service.name }}:{{ $.Values.global.nrf.service.port }}
      nrfCertPem: ./cert/nrf.pem # NRF Certificate
      {{- .configuration.urrConfiguration | nindent 6 }}
      pfcp:
{{- if $.Values.global.smf.multus.enabled }}
        nodeID: {{ $.Values.global.smf.multus.n4if.ipAddress }}
        listenAddr: {{ $.Values.global.smf.multus.n4if.ipAddress }}
        externalAddr: {{ $.Values.global.smf.multus.n4if.ipAddress }}
{{- else }}
        nodeID: POD_IP_ADDR
        listenAddr: POD_IP_ADDR
        externalAddr: POD_IP_ADDR
{{- end }}

      {{- include (printf "free5gc-smf.%sConfig" $arch) $ | nindent 6 }}

    logger:
      {{- toYaml .configuration.logger | nindent 6 }}


  uerouting.yaml: |
    info:
      version: 1.0.7
      description: Routing information for UE
    ueRoutingInfo:
      {{- include (printf "free5gc-smf.%sUeRoutingInfo" $arch) $ | nindent 6 }}

    exec /free5gc/upf -c {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml
{{- else }}
    # Dynamic Pod IP mode: Single interface (eth0)
    # Get Pod IP dynamically
    POD_IP=$(hostname -i | awk '{print $1}')
    echo "[wrapper] psaupf1 (AnchorUPF1) Pod IP detected: $POD_IP"

    # Copy config to writable location
    cp {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    # Replace POD_IP_ADDR placeholder with actual Pod IP
    sed -i "s/POD_IP_ADDR/$POD_IP/g" /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    echo "[wrapper] psaupf1 PFCP config:"
    cat /tmp/upfcfg.yaml | grep -A3 "pfcp:"

    # Wait for upfgtp interface to be created by gtp5g module
    echo "[wrapper] Waiting for upfgtp interface..."
    for i in $(seq 1 30); do
      if ip link show upfgtp > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[wrapper] upfgtp interface is ready"
        break
      fi
      sleep 1
    done

    # Note: Route for UE subnet will be automatically added by UPF based on dnnList configuration
    # No need to manually add route here

    # Setup iptables for NAT (single interface mode - eth0)
    iptables -A FORWARD -j ACCEPT
    # NAT traffic from UE subnet going out via eth0 (for uplink to internet)
    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE

    {{- if $.Values.psaupf1.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.psaupf1.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | toYaml | indent 2 }}

global:
  free5gcReleaseName: free5gc-helm  # Name of the free5gc helm release
  gnb:
    multus:
      enabled: false
      n2network:
        enabled: true
        name: n2network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.248
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.254
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.254
      n3network:
        enabled: true
        name: n3network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.232
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.238
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.238

gnb:

    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  configmap:
    name: gnb-configmap
  volume:
    name: gnb-volume
    mount: /ueransim/config
  service:
    name: gnb-service
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 4997
    protocol: UDP

  n2if:  # NGAP
    ipAddress: 10.100.50.250
  n3if:  # GTP-U
    ipAddress: 10.100.50.236

  amf:
    n2if:  # NGAP
      ipAddress: 10.100.50.249
      serviceName: free5gc-amf-amf-n2
      port: 38412
    service:
      ngap:
        enabled: false

  podAnnotations: {}
  imagePullSecrets: []
  podSecurityContext: {}
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 256Mi
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}

  configuration: |-
    mcc: '208' # Mobile Country Code value
    mnc: '93'  # Mobile Network Code value (2 or 3 digits)
    nci: '0x000000010'  # NR Cell Identity (36-bit)
    idLength: 32        # NR gNB ID length in bits [22...32]
    tac: 1     # Tracking Area Code
    slices:
      - sst: 0x1
        sd: 0x010203
    ignoreStreamIds: true
ue:
  enabled: true
  name: ue
  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    name: free5gc/ueransim
    tag: v4.0.1
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  configmap:
    name: ue-configmap
  volume:
    name: ue-volume
    mount: /ueransim/config
  command: "./nr-ue -c ./config/ue-config.yaml"  # This is the command that will be launched in the UE container
  script: ""

  podAnnotations: {}
  imagePullSecrets: []
  podSecurityContext: {}
  securityContext:
    capabilities:
            add: ["NET_ADMIN"]
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}

  configuration: |-
    supi: "imsi-208930000000001"  # IMSI number
    mcc: "208" # Mobile Country Code value
    mnc: "93" # Mobile Network Code value (2 or 3 digits)
    key: "8baf473f2f8fd09487cccbd7097c6862" # Operator code (OP or OPC) of the UE
    op: "8e27b6af0e692e750f32667a3b14605d" # This value specifies the OP type and it can be either 'OP' or 'OPC'
    opType: "OPC" # This value specifies the OP type and it can be either 'OP' or 'OPC'
    amf: "8000" # Authentication Management Field (AMF) value
    imei: "356938035643803" # IMEI number of the device
    imeiSv: "4370816125816151"
    uacAic:
      mps: false
      mcs: false
    uacAcc:
      normalClass: 0
      class11: false
      class12: false
      class13: false
      class14: false
      class15: false
    sessions:
      - type: "IPv4"
        apn: "internet"
        slice:
          sst: 0x01
          sd: 0x010203
    configured-nssai:
      - sst: 0x01
        sd: 0x010203
    default-nssai:
      - sst: 1
        sd: 1
    integrity:
      IA1: true
      IA2: true
      IA3: true
    ciphering:
      EA1: true
      EA2: true
      EA3: true
    integrityMaxRate:
      uplink: "full"
      downlink: "full"

  test:
    connectivity:
      name: ue-connectivity-test
      image: bitnami/kubectl:1.22.0
      configmap:
        name: connectivity-test-configmap
      volume:
        name: connectivity-test-volume
        mount: /scripts
      ttlseconds: 50

# Author: Abderaouf KHICHANE, Ilhem FAJJARI, Ayoub BOUSSELMI
# Software description: An open-source project providing Helm charts to deploy 5G components (Core + RAN) on top of Kubernetes
#
{{- with .Values.gnb }}
{{- if .enabled }}
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .configmap.name }}
  labels:
    app: {{ $.Values.projectName }}
    component: {{ .name }}
data:
  gnb-config.yaml: |

    {{- .configuration | nindent 4 }}
    
{{- if $.Values.global.gnb.multus.enabled }}
    linkIp: 0.0.0.0   # gNB's local IP address for Radio Link Simulation (listen on all interfaces for UE connection)
{{- if .amf.service.ngap.enabled }}
    ngapIp: 0.0.0.0
{{- else }}
    ngapIp: {{ .n2if.ipAddress }} 
{{- end }}
    gtpIp: {{ .n3if.ipAddress }}    # gNB's local IP address for N3 Interface
    
    # List of AMF address information
    amfConfigs:
      - address: {{ .amf.n2if.ipAddress }}
        port: {{ .amf.n2if.port }}
{{- else }}
    linkIp: GNB_POD_IP   # gNB's local IP address for Radio Link Simulation
    ngapIp: GNB_POD_IP   # gNB's local IP address for N2 Interface
    gtpIp: GNB_POD_IP    # gNB's local IP address for N3 Interface
    
    # List of AMF address information
    amfConfigs:
      - address: {{ $.Values.global.free5gcReleaseName }}-{{ .amf.n2if.serviceName }}
        port: {{ .amf.n2if.port }}
{{- end }}

  wrapper.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    set -e
    
{{- if $.Values.global.gnb.multus.enabled }}
    # Multus mode: Static IPs are configured, run gNB directly
    echo "[gNB wrapper] Multus mode enabled - using static IP configuration"
    exec ./nr-gnb -c /ueransim/config/gnb-config.yaml
{{- else }}
    # Dynamic Pod IP mode
    # Get Pod IP dynamically
    POD_IP=$(hostname -i | awk '{print $1}')
    echo "[gNB wrapper] Pod IP detected: $POD_IP"
    
    # Copy config to writable location
    cp /ueransim/config/gnb-config.yaml /tmp/gnb-config.yaml
    
    # Replace POD_IP placeholder
    sed -i "s/GNB_POD_IP/$POD_IP/g" /tmp/gnb-config.yaml
    
    echo "[gNB wrapper] Configuration prepared:"
    cat /tmp/gnb-config.yaml | grep -E "linkIp|ngapIp|gtpIp"
    
    # Execute gNB
    exec ./nr-gnb -c /tmp/gnb-config.yaml
{{- end }}

{{- end }}
{{- end }}

mongodb:
  extraDeploy: []
  persistence:
    storageClass: local-path
EOF

content.thinking: SMF 隨機選到了 AnchorUPF2，而預設路徑只認 AnchorUPF1，所以沒套用；我已移除 AnchorUPF2 的 UE IP pool，讓它不再作為預設 anchor。

input.command:
cd /home/vagrant/work/deploy; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='charts/free5gc/charts/free5gc-smf/templates/_smf-ulcl.tpl'
s=open(p).read()
old='''            - dnn: internet
              pools:
                - cidr: 10.60.128.0/17
'''
new='''            # MEC-dedicated PSA: intentionally NO UE IP pool, so SMF never picks it as the
            # default anchor; it is only reachable through the UE-routing specificPath.
            - dnn: internet
'''
assert s.count(old)==1
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
EOF
helm upgrade free5gc-helm charts/free5gc -n free5gc -f values-free5gc.yaml | head -3
kubectl -n free5gc get pods | grep -E 'smf|upf'; kubectl -n free5gc get deploy free5gc-helm-free5gc-smf-smf -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.metadata.annotations}'

cd /home/vagrant/work/deploy; N=free5gc
for u in iupf1 psaupf1 psaupf2; do kubectl -n $N scale deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-upf-$u --replicas=0; done
cat >> values-free5gc.yaml <<'EOF'
# Node is small (4 CPU, requests ~98% used): lower UPF CPU requests so rolling restarts can schedule.
iupf1:
  resources: {requests: {cpu: 250m, memory: 512Mi}, limits: {cpu: 1000m, memory: 1024Mi}}
psaupf1:
  resources: {requests: {cpu: 250m, memory: 512Mi}, limits: {cpu: 1000m, memory: 1024Mi}}
psaupf2:
  resources: {requests: {cpu: 250m, memory: 512Mi}, limits: {cpu: 1000m, memory: 1024Mi}}
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
# merge duplicated top-level keys: psaupf1/psaupf2 appear twice in the values file -> rebuild cleanly
import re
s=open('values-free5gc.yaml').read()
print(s.count('psaupf1:'))
EOF

input.command:
cd /home/vagrant/work/deploy; cat > values-free5gc.yaml <<'EOF'
# free5GC v4.3.0 ULCL (1 I-UPF + 2 PSA-UPF) on single-node K3s, no Multus.
global:
  userPlaneArchitecture: ulcl
  uesubnet: 10.60.0.0/16

# UE IPs are allocated from PSA-UPF1's pool (10.60.0.0/17), but PSA-UPF2 (MEC) must also be able
# to route return traffic for those UEs to its upfgtp device -> both PSAs get the full /16 route.
# Node is small (4 CPU, requests ~98% used): UPF CPU requests lowered so restarts can schedule.
iupf1:
  resources: {requests: {cpu: 250m, memory: 512Mi}, limits: {cpu: 1000m, memory: 1024Mi}}
psaupf1:
  resources: {requests: {cpu: 250m, memory: 512Mi}, limits: {cpu: 1000m, memory: 1024Mi}}
  configuration:
    dnnList:
      - dnn: internet
        cidr: 10.60.0.0/16
psaupf2:
  resources: {requests: {cpu: 250m, memory: 512Mi}, limits: {cpu: 1000m, memory: 1024Mi}}
  configuration:
    dnnList:
      - dnn: internet
        cidr: 10.60.0.0/16

# The chart ships a static PV bound to node "free5gc" / class "microk8s-hostpath";
# on this K3s cluster use the default local-path provisioner instead.
mongodb:
  extraDeploy: []
  persistence:
    storageClass: local-path
EOF
N=free5gc
helm upgrade free5gc-helm charts/free5gc -n $N -f values-free5gc.yaml | head -2
for u in iupf1 psaupf1 psaupf2; do kubectl -n $N scale deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-upf-$u --replicas=1 >/dev/null; done
for u in iupf1 psaupf1 psaupf2; do kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-upf-$u --timeout=150s; done
kubectl -n $N get pods | grep -E 'upf|smf|gnb|ue'

#!/bin/bash
# Clean restart of the user plane + RAN in the right order (SMF resolves UPF pod IPs at start-up).
N=free5gc; R=free5gc-helm-free5gc
for u in iupf1 psaupf1 psaupf2; do kubectl -n $N scale deploy/$R-upf-$u --replicas=0 >/dev/null; done

sleep 5
for u in iupf1 psaupf1 psaupf2; do kubectl -n $N scale deploy/$R-upf-$u --replicas=1 >/dev/null; done
for u in iupf1 psaupf1 psaupf2; do kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/$R-upf-$u --timeout=150s | tail -1; done
kubectl -n $N rollout restart deploy/$R-smf-smf >/dev/null; kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/$R-smf-smf --timeout=150s | tail -1
kubectl -n $N scale deploy/ueransim-gnb --replicas=1 >/dev/null; kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/ueransim-gnb --timeout=100s | tail -1
kubectl -n $N scale deploy/ueransim-ue --replicas=1 >/dev/null; kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/ueransim-ue --timeout=100s | tail -1
EOF

content.thinking: 设定渲染正常，但 SMF 判定 AnchorUPF2 为 DNN mismatch；先前的随机选择其实是 ulcl 旗标没开造成的，开启后预设 anchor 由 UE routing 群组决定，所以我会把 AnchorUPF2 的 pool 还原成 chart 原样。

input.command:
cd /home/vagrant/work/deploy; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='charts/free5gc/charts/free5gc-smf/templates/_smf-ulcl.tpl'
s=open(p).read()
new='''            - dnn: internet
              pools:
                - cidr: 10.60.128.0/17
'''
old='''            # MEC-dedicated PSA: intentionally NO UE IP pool, so SMF never picks it as the
            # default anchor; it is only reachable through the UE-routing specificPath.
            - dnn: internet
'''
assert old in s
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
EOF
diff -u charts.orig/free5gc/charts/free5gc-smf/templates/_smf-ulcl.tpl charts/free5gc/charts/free5gc-smf/templates/_smf-ulcl.tpl | grep '^[+-]'
helm upgrade free5gc-helm charts/free5gc -n free5gc -f values-free5gc.yaml | head -2; ./recycle.sh; sleep 10
N=free5gc; kubectl -n $N logs deploy/ueransim-ue | tail -1; kubectl -n $N logs deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-smf-smf 2>&1 | grep -E "Selected UPF|Allocated UE|pre-config|Skipping|PSA2|Add PSA|AddPDUSession" | cut -c1-220

content.thinking: 找到原因了：v4.3.0 的 SMF 要求 PSA2 自己同时声明该 DNN 的 N3 与 N9，而 chart 的 AnchorUPF2 只声明了 N9，所以 MEC 路径被跳过。我会在 AnchorUPF2 补上指向自身 Pod IP 的 N3 介面宣告，不影响 UPF 本身。

input.command:
cd /home/vagrant/work/deploy; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='charts/free5gc/charts/free5gc-smf/templates/_smf-ulcl.tpl'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.index('    AnchorUPF2:')
j=s.index('        - interfaceType: N9', i)
ins='''        # SMF v4.3.0 (SelectPSA2) requires the PSA that terminates the specificPath to expose both an N3
        # and an N9 interface for the DNN, otherwise the path is skipped with "DNN mismatch".
        - interfaceType: N3
          endpoints:
            - {{ if .Values.global.smf.multus.enabled }}{{ .Values.global.upf.multus.psaupf2.n9if.ipAddress }}{{ else }}PSAUPF2_SERVICE_NAME{{ end }}
          networkInstances:
            - internet
'''
s=s[:j]+ins+s[j:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

cd /home/vagrant/work/deploy; cat > verify.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Verifies which UPF carries which traffic. Uses upfgtp packet counters inside each UPF pod.
N=free5gc; R=free5gc-helm-free5gc
UEPOD=$(kubectl -n $N get pod -o name | grep ueransim-ue)
cnt() { # $1=upf name -> "rx tx" packets on upfgtp (gtp5g device) of that UPF pod
  kubectl -n $N exec deploy/$R-upf-$1 -- awk '/upfgtp/{gsub(":"," ");print $3, $11}' /proc/net/dev
}
snap() { for u in iupf1 psaupf1 psaupf2; do echo "$u $(cnt $u)"; done; }
delta() { # prints per-UPF delta between two snapshots
  join <(echo "$1") <(echo "$2") | awk '{printf "  %-8s upfgtp rx_pkts +%d  tx_pkts +%d\n",$1,$4-$2,$5-$3}'
}
echo "UE tunnel:"; kubectl -n $N exec $UEPOD -c ue -- ip -4 addr show uesimtun0 | grep inet
echo; echo "=== A) Traffic to MEC (http://10.43.200.10/ x10) ==="
b=$(snap)
for i in $(seq 10); do kubectl -n $N exec $UEPOD -c curl -- curl -s -m 5 -o /dev/null --interface uesimtun0 http://10.43.200.10/; done
a=$(snap); delta "$b" "$a"
echo "  MEC app sees client (RemoteAddr):"; kubectl -n $N exec $UEPOD -c curl -- curl -s -m 5 --interface uesimtun0 http://10.43.200.10/ | grep -E "Hostname|RemoteAddr"
echo; echo "=== B) Traffic to Internet (ping 8.8.8.8 x20 + 1.1.1.1 x20) ==="
b=$(snap)
kubectl -n $N exec $UEPOD -c ue -- ping -I uesimtun0 -c 20 -i 0.2 -q 8.8.8.8 | tail -2
kubectl -n $N exec $UEPOD -c ue -- ping -I uesimtun0 -c 20 -i 0.2 -q 1.1.1.1 | tail -2
a=$(snap); delta "$b" "$a"
echo; echo "UPF pod IPs:"; kubectl -n $N get pod -o wide | grep upf | awk '{print "  "$1, $6}'
EOF
chmod +x verify.sh; ./verify.sh

cd /home/vagrant/work/deploy; python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('verify.sh').read()

''','''UEPOD=$(kubectl -n $N get pod -o name | grep ueransim-ue)
# curl is not in the UERANSIM image: attach a curl ephemeral container (same netns => same uesimtun0)

  kubectl -n $N debug $UEPOD -c curl --image=curlimages/curl:8.7.1 --target=ue --quiet -- sleep 86400 >/dev/null 2>&1
  kubectl -n $N wait --for=jsonpath='{.status.ephemeralContainerStatuses[0].state.running}' $UEPOD --timeout=60s >/dev/null; }
''')
s=s.replace('''cnt() { # $1=upf name -> "rx tx" packets on upfgtp (gtp5g device) of that UPF pod
  kubectl -n $N exec deploy/$R-upf-$1 -- awk '/upfgtp/{gsub(":"," ");print $3, $11}' /proc/net/dev
}''','''cnt() { # $1=upf -> "gtp_rx gtp_tx eth0_rx eth0_tx" packets (upfgtp = gtp5g device, eth0 = N3/N9/N6 of pod)
  kubectl -n $N exec deploy/$R-upf-$1 -- awk '/upfgtp:/{gsub(":"," ");a=$3;b=$11} /eth0:/{gsub(":"," ");c=$3;d=$11} END{print a,b,c,d}' /proc/net/dev
}''')
s=s.replace('''  join <(echo "$1") <(echo "$2") | awk '{printf "  %-8s upfgtp rx_pkts +%d  tx_pkts +%d\\n",$1,$4-$2,$5-$3}\'''','''  join <(echo "$1") <(echo "$2") | awk '{printf "  %-8s upfgtp(rx,tx) +%d,+%d   eth0(rx,tx) +%d,+%d\\n",$1,$6-$2,$7-$3,$8-$4,$9-$5}\'''')
open('verify.sh','w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "join" verify.sh; ./verify.sh

cd /home/vagrant/work/deploy; cat > values-free5gc.yaml <<'EOF'
# free5GC v4.3.0 ULCL (1 I-UPF + 2 PSA-UPF) on single-node K3s, no Multus.
global:
  userPlaneArchitecture: ulcl
  uesubnet: 10.60.0.0/16

# --- UPF sub-chart overrides (must live under the sub-chart name) ---
free5gc-upf:
  # Node is small (4 CPU, requests ~98% used): lower UPF CPU requests so restarts can schedule.
  iupf1:
    resources: {requests: {cpu: 250m, memory: 512Mi}, limits: {cpu: 1000m, memory: 1024Mi}}
  # UE IPs come from PSA-UPF1's pool (10.60.0.0/17); the MEC PSA-UPF2 must also route/accept the whole

content.text:
UE 已註冊並建好 PDU session，ULCL 分流驗證有效：到 MEC 的流量走 PSA-UPF2，上網流量走 PSA-UPF1。

## (1) 部署的元件與設定

**部署內容**（namespace `free5gc`）
- Helm release `free5gc-helm`：free5GC v4.3.0 全部 NF，加上 MongoDB 和 WebUI。使用者面是 3 個 UPF：`iupf1` 是 I-UPF（ULCL／branching UPF，接 gNB），`psaupf1` 是上網用 PSA，`psaupf2` 是 MEC 專用 PSA。
- Helm release `ueransim`：1 個 gNB、1 個 UE。
- Chart 用 `free5gc-helm` 的 commit `07139fc…`，只改了一個檔案。
- 沒有動 `mec` namespace 的 `mec-app`。

**設定**
- PLMN 208/93、SST 1／SD 010203、DNN `internet`、SUPI `imsi-208930000000001`。
- 訂閱資料用 WebUI REST API 寫入，K/OPc 與 UE 設定一致。
- `userPlaneArchitecture: ulcl`，不用 Multus，全部走 Pod IP。
- 預設路徑是 gNB → I-UPF → PSA1。特定路徑是目的地 `10.43.200.10/32` 走 I-UPF → PSA2。

**對 chart 的修改**（diff 在 `/home/vagrant/work/deploy/chart-changes.diff`，只動 `_smf-ulcl.tpl`；values 在 `values-free5gc.yaml`）
1. **UE 路由**：把範例的 `1.0.0.1/32` 和 UE2 換成 MEC 的 `10.43.200.10/32`。
2. **SMF 加 `ulcl: true`**：chart 沒設，SMF 因此完全忽略 ULCL 路由，只建單一預設路徑。
3. **AnchorUPF2 補宣告 N3 介面**：v4.3.0 的 SMF 要求 PSA2 同時有 N3 和 N9，否則 MEC 路徑會被跳過（日誌 `DNN mismatch`）。這是我讀 SMF 原始碼找到的，我沒有逐版本確認 v4.3.0 附的 SMF 就是這個行為。
4. **兩個 PSA 的 DNN cidr 都改成 `10.60.0.0/16`**：UE 的 IP 來自 PSA1 的 `/17`，PSA2 原本只認 `/17` 的另一半，MEC 回程封包無法回到 `upfgtp`。
5. **MongoDB 改用 `local-path`**：chart 內建的 PV 綁死節點名 `free5gc` 和 `microk8s-hostpath`，在這個叢集上排不起來。
6. **UPF 的 CPU request 從 500m 降到 250m**：節點 request 已佔 98%，重啟時新 Pod 排不進去。

## (2) 怎麼確認分流正確

- **控制面**：SMF 日誌依序出現 `Selected UPF: AnchorUPF1`、`Has pre-config ULCL paths`、`Establish PSA2`、`Add PSA success`。UE IP 是 `10.60.0.1`（PSA1 的 pool）。
- **MEC 流量**：`10.43.200.10` 是 whoami 服務。UE 經 `uesimtun0` 對它發 curl，它回報的 `RemoteAddr` 是 `10.42.0.91`，也就是 psaupf2 的 Pod IP。10 次請求的封包計數如下：

  | UPF | `upfgtp` 收／發 |
  |---|---|
  | psaupf2 | +60／+40 |
  | psaupf1 | 0／0 |

- **上網流量**：經 `uesimtun0` ping 8.8.8.8 和 1.1.1.1 各 20 個，全部成功、0% 遺失。psaupf1 的 `upfgtp` 是 +40／+40，psaupf2 是 0／0。HTTP 查到的對外 IP 和主機自己的相同（`140.113.110.82`），所以出口是節點 NAT。
- **I-UPF**：它做 GTP 到 GTP 的核心轉發，不經 `upfgtp`，所以改看 `eth0` 計數：兩種測試都有大量封包通過（MEC 約 +109／+105，上網約 +90／+87）。
